# v1.10.1 — Cleaner supplier order export

- Updated the web and mobile supplier email/share export to include only the text users entered for each open item.
- Removed the `(Projekt — Ploča)` origin suffix from exported order lines; the origin remains visible in the app’s list.
- Retained the open-items-only export behavior introduced in v1.10.0.

## Verification

- Verified the browser mailto body and clipboard content; Flutter 3.24.3 analysis passed and all 9 Flutter tests passed.
- Mobile package version: **1.10.1+11**.
